Rejected drafts on S.’s youth in the Dedication to L&C (see note to stanza 3, Longman ii 50)
include the lines:

paragraphs.source_en:
. . . and dreams divine my heart had nursed
Till it grew strong on night-dividing wings . . .
 I feared not those who ruled, nor did I hate
Mine equals, but was lone, untameable
Like some wild beast that cannot find its mate
A solitary gazelle [ ]
Which in the desert wilderness doth dwell
Secure in its own swiftness
